data.title: A room worth changing

memoryNodes.cue: One room becomes the focus of a project.
Different students can work within a small budget.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 不同专业的学生可以在有限预算内合作。

data.situation:
Dr Chen met them beside a small model. His work was in engineering: designing and building things that solved practical problems. Jo showed him a photograph of the centre’s reading room. Originally, the room had been used for storage. It now held a reading club, but it was bright, crowded and difficult to use. Maya had a project in mind: find a few changes the centre could afford. Maya: Could we turn this room into a case study?
Dr Chen: Yes, if you examine it in detail rather than claim it represents every centre.
Jo: We have a little funding for equipment, but not for rebuilding.
Dr Chen: Then make the research fit that question. Our design students and psychology students can help—it would be an interdisciplinary project.

readingBlocks.en: Dr Chen met them beside a small model. His work was in engineering: designing and building things that solved practical problems. Jo showed him a photograph of the centre’s reading room. Originally, the room had been used for storage. It now held a reading club, but it was bright, crowded and difficult to use. Maya had a project in mind: find a few changes the centre could afford.
readingBlocks.zh: 陈博士在一个小模型旁接待她们。他从事工程，设计和制作能解决实际问题的东西。乔给他看中心阅览室的照片。最初，这个房间用来储物。如今这里举办阅读社团，却太亮、拥挤，使用不便。玛雅想做一个项目：找出中心负担得起的几项改动。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: Could we turn this room into a case study?
Dr Chen: Yes, if you examine it in detail rather than claim it represents every centre.
Jo: We have a little funding for equipment, but not for rebuilding.
Dr Chen: Then make the research fit that question. Our design students and psychology students can help—it would be an interdisciplinary project.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：能把这个房间作为案例研究吗？
陈博士：可以，但要详细考察它，不要声称它代表所有中心。
乔：我们有一点设备资金，没有重建的钱。
陈博士：那就让研究围绕这个问题。设计专业和心理学专业的学生可以帮忙——这会是跨学科项目。

glossary.note: 学科或工作领域，通常不可数。
glossary.example: Engineering involves designing and building useful structures or machines.
glossary.exampleZh: 工程涉及设计和建造有用的结构或机器。

externalEvidence.definition: the discipline dealing with the art or science of applying scientific knowledge to practical problems

glossary.zh: 有明确目标、经过安排的一项工作；项目
glossary.note: a project；不是投射的动词义。
glossary.example: The project aims to improve one reading room.
glossary.exampleZh: 该项目旨在改善一间阅览室。

glossary.note: 说明起初的情况，区别于新颖地。
glossary.example: Originally, the room was used for storage.

externalEvidence.definition: with reference to the origin or beginning

glossary.zh: 对一个具体对象的深入案例研究
glossary.note: 具体案例的详细考察，不自动代表整体。
glossary.example: They made the reading room a case study.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们把阅览室作为案例研究。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Detailed situation studied; local WordNet narrows to social unit success/failure or person/group clinical view.

glossary.zh: 为特定目的提供的资金
glossary.note: 不可数；funding for，不是捐款动作。
glossary.example: The centre has limited funding for equipment.
glossary.exampleZh: 中心用于设备的资金有限。

externalEvidence.definition: financial resources provided to make some project possible

glossary.zh: 为获取知识而开展的系统研究
glossary.note: 通常不可数；do/conduct research，避免a research。
glossary.example: Their research focuses on how people use the room.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们的研究关注人们怎样使用房间。

glossary.note: involving more than one field of study。
glossary.example: Design and psychology students joined the interdisciplinary project.
glossary.exampleZh: 设计和心理学专业的学生加入跨学科项目。

externalEvidence.definition: drawing from or characterized by participation of two or more fields of study
